Name: (CP)(FS) Churpy's Vivid Hairstyles - Herb Garden Set
Author: Churpix
Description:
Hello! I'm so sorry for the delay, but here are some masculine, neutral, and feminine hairstyles! A lot of people asked for short feminine hair and curly/textured hairstyles. I hope you like them! All styles were created by me from scratch.

I left this set incomplete so I can take suggestions on other hairstyles that the community wants in the game. Please leave a comment if there is something specific you'd like to see!

Also-- I apologize for the lack of screenshots/images. I haven't had time to update my mod list for 1.6 so I'll try to include those ASAP :-)

Each hairstyle is tinted with different undertones to give a wider range of colour possibilities. When you colour pick your hairstyle in-game, the colour will be affected by the base hairstyle tint:
══ ❀•°❀°•❀ ══
[b]Warm Tones[/b]
Rose
Lemon

[b]Cool Tones[/b]
Lavender
Mint
══ ❀•°❀°•❀ ══

An untinted version is also included for a natural white hair look!


══ ❀•°❀°•❀ ══
[b]IMPORTANT
THE CONTENT PATCHER VERSION OF THIS MOD IS CURRENTLY NOT COMPATIBLE WITH MY OTHER MOD: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19125 

I will be releasing a separate version with compatibility, but for now please use the Fashion Sense version if you'd like to use all of my hairstyles[/b].

All hairstyles included in this set are made for Peach Body chubby ver. found [url=https://blog.naver.com/codnjsdl8235/222314151470]here[/url]. I cannot guarantee that this mod will look good and may have visual issues 

This mod creates 60 new hairstyle slots in the character creation menu. It does not overwrite any vanilla hairstyles. Thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/113270318]halpyy[/url] as I referenced your mod's code and file structure for Content Patcher to create mine!
